decisions.rationale: The three displayed losses are reported accurately, but calling them the three evaluated losses incorrectly excludes four additional paired losses with positive average gains.
It correctly notes the GPT-2 setting and absent significance tests, but falsely limits testing to three losses and omits other stated evidential limitations.
The displayed gains are accurate, but “three evaluated KD losses” understates scope because four additional paired losses also had positive average gains.
The passage correctly identifies GPT-2-only evidence and absent significance tests, but incorrectly says only three losses were tested and incompletely characterizes the limitations.
The reported gains for GKD, KLD, and SRKL are correct, but describing these as all evaluated losses excludes four additional paired losses reported in the note.
